sloka: इमानि च महार्हाणि वस्त्राण्Yआभरणानि च ।प्रतिगृह्य विशालाक्ष मातुलस्य च दापय ॥२-७०-४॥
transliteration: imāni ca mahārhāṇi vastrāṇYābharaṇāni ca ।pratigṛhya viśālākṣa mātulasya ca dāpaya ॥2-70-4॥

translations.english: Oh largeeyed one (Bharata) you are asked to take these excellent raiments and precious ornaments and bestow them on your maternal uncle (said the messengers).
translations.hindi: तब सब ने हीवसिष्ट जी से कहा कि, दूत अभी जाने चाहिए । उनका यह वचन सुन वसिष्ठ जो बोले
